## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `microsoft-sharepoint-sites-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Register an application and generate credentials

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [Microsoft Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/) using your Microsoft 365 account credentials. -->
2. In the top search bar, select **Microsoft Entra ID**.
3. <!-- manual: In the left panel, navigate to App registrations and click New registration. -->
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name for your application, select the appropriate Supported account types (e.g., "Single tenant only"), and click Register. -->
5. Once the application is registered, copy the **Application (client) ID** and **Directory (tenant) ID** from the Overview page.
6. <!-- manual: Navigate to Certificates & secrets in the left panel, click New client secret, provide a description and expiry period, then click Add. Copy the generated client secret value immediately — it cannot be retrieved later. -->

## Step 3: Configure API permissions

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to API permissions in the left panel and click Add a permission. -->
2. Select **Microsoft Graph** from the available API options.
3. Select **Application permissions**, then search for and add the permissions that match your use case before clicking **Add permissions**. :::tip Grant only the permissions your application actually requires. For read-only use cases, `Sites.Read.All` is sufficient. For full connector coverage, add all four. :::
4. <!-- manual: add the permissions that match your use case before clicking Add permissions. :::tip Grant only the permissions your application actually requires -->
5. Select **Grant admin consent** to approve the permissions for your organization.
